name: TRINX 千里达 Tornado 900 / 龙卷风900
why_interesting: The blue-white card resolves to the current TRINX TDO / Tornado 900 Shimano 105 R7120 2x12 carbon build. A current specialist retailer claims approximately 8.1 kg, but maximum tire clearance and meaningful stiffness evidence remain unknown.

facts.drivetrain: Shimano 105 R7120 mechanical 2x12 with hydraulic BR-R7170 disc brakes
facts.frame: TRINX TDO 900 T800 carbon aero road frame and carbon fork
facts.frame_material: T800 carbon frame, carbon fork, carbon handlebar and carbon seatpost; cockpit integration is unverified
facts.complete_weight_basis: Current exact-model specialist-retailer approximate claim for the matching Factory Team / Shimano 105 / carbon-wheel build; size, pedals, accessories and weighing method are not stated and the value is not independently measured
facts.wheels: TRINX carbon 700C wheelset on the documented manufacturer build
facts.tires: Grand Sport Race 700x28C fitted on the manufacturer build; no maximum is published
facts.cockpit current reference: Current exact manufacturer page explicitly lists an integrated carbon bent handlebar; assembly dimensions and retained selected build remain unverified.
facts.sizes current reference: Current manufacturer TDO 900 reference sizes: 450, 480, 510 and 530.
facts.manufacturer reference chain: SHIMANO CN-M7100. Exact current manufacturer TDO900 R7120/BR-R7170 complete reference. Does not establish retained selected production-batch substitutions.
facts.manufacturer reference saddle: Selle Italia SRX. Same exact current manufacturer build; no saddle weight or retained production-batch guarantee.

missing: Controlled or sufficiently specific independent frame-stiffness evidence

source_note: Manufacturer and mainland indexes align on the blue-white Shimano 105 R7120 2x12 carbon build. The 8.1 kg value is retained only as an approximate retailer claim with its missing basis, and fitted 28C tires are not inferred to be the maximum.
